## Task T3.1 — Results Summary

### Steps Completed

| # | Step | Result |
|---|------|--------|
| 1 | Loaded `results_seed42.csv` (70 rows) + `results_seed123.csv` (70 rows) | ✅ Concatenated → 140 rows |
| 2 | Verified 140 rows; checked all (size, condition, seed, epoch) combos | ✅ Complete — grid used **size=2500** (not 2000, as A3 executed) |
| 3 | Saved `analysis/results_all.csv` | ✅ 140 rows × 7 cols |
| 4 | Filtered epoch==5 (28 rows), pivoted wide, saved `analysis/test_acc_summary.csv` | ✅ 14 rows × 4 cols |
| 5 | Calibration check: acc_noaug at size=60000 | ✅ Both seeds (0.9140, 0.9157) within [0.85, 0.93] — no warnings |
| 6 | Extracted GPU device strings from both log files → `analysis/gpu_device_info.txt` | ✅ Both runs: **NVIDIA L4** |

### Key Observations for Downstream Analysis (T3.2)
- **acc_aug < acc_noaug at all sizes** — augmentation hurts at 5 epochs (this will produce all negative Δ values, a notable diagnostic flag for T3.2)
- **acc_noaug ranges:** 0.732 (N=500) → 0.916 (N=60,000), monotonically increasing
- **No NaN values** in test_acc at epoch 5

### Artifacts Produced
- `analysis/results_all.csv` — master table, 140 rows
- `analysis/test_acc_summary.csv` — wide-format accuracy table, 14 rows
- `analysis/gpu_device_info.txt` — NVIDIA L4 confirmed for both seeds
